task.name: Set_up_camp_shower_and_sink
task.when: During Build after fresh-water and gray-water locations are confirmed

step.action: Confirm the current shower, sink, potable-water, pump, and gray-water diagram in 📦 Build_Book.
Place the shower and sink on the mapped level footprints outside traffic and drainage paths.
Assemble and secure the shower enclosure and sink according to the approved diagram.
Have the Water Lead connect the potable-water lines in the printed sequence.
Have the Water Lead connect the shower, sink, pump, and gray-water lines in the printed sequence.
Run the minimum water needed through each fixture to test flow and drainage.
step.ifThen: IF water leaks, pools, or fails to reach 🔧 Gray-Water_IBC, THEN close the supply, keep the fixture out of service, and tell the Water Lead.

passWhen.criterion: The shower and sink are stable and secured in their mapped positions.
Potable water flows and all used test water reaches the gray-water IBC.
No leak, puddle, or exposed trip hazard is present.
The Water Lead completed the final inspection.
